creative_direction: Draw Megumi Fushiguro near an implied window, with his characteristic spiky dark hair and a quiet direct gaze. Use a plain charcoal casual jacket with a soft open collar, keeping his age and lean face recognizable. His torso turns a little to the left, but his head returns toward the viewer so both eyes remain visible. Use hand-drawn ink contours with small pressure changes and restrained sage washes. A single pale vertical background band suggests the window without adding a scene. The mouth is neutral, the brow unstrained, and the hair tips remain inside the circular crop. Give both visible irises soft violet Rinnegan rings with a clear dark pupil and bright catchlights. Keep the rings fine and contained so the gaze remains warm and readable. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
